title: Machine learning allows robust classification of visceral fat in women with obesity using common laboratory metrics
summary: The primary clinical study tests whether learned classifiers can group women with obesity by DXA-defined visceral-fat categories using common laboratory metrics. It reports limited, cohort-specific discrimination and does not establish a replacement for direct measurement. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
